notes.title: New farming machines
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey there, cyber farmers![/b][/h3][p][/p][p]Get ready — powerful and brand [u][b]new farming machines[/b][/u] are rolling into town![/p][p]Technological progress has brought some serious upgrades to the world of crop cultivation — stuff Zalesie’s never seen before!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/YgKKABi.gif[/img]

Back in the day, Kaz’ Grandpa had to plow the fields with a horse-drawn rig and sow the seeds by hand. Now? The only horses you need are under the hood of a modern, remote-controlled plow that can do in minutes what used to take half a day. And it’s not just fast — it’s more agile, and let’s be honest… attracts way fewer flies than a horse!

[img]https://i.imgur.com/PBhvOoR.gif[/img]

Once the ground's plowed, it’s time to sow. For that, fire up your trusty drone — it can handle even massive fields in a flash, and it doesn’t care much about rough terrain either. Just watch out for trees and barns… if it gets stuck, you might still need an old-school ladder to get it down! 🌾🤖[/p][p]
[img src="https://i.imgur.com/KOl1ywd.gif"][/img][/p]

tags.feature: new farming machines

notes.title: Cyber Farmer - Look Inside
notes.content:
[h2]Hello Farmers![/h2]

[h3]We're preparing the next chapter in the history of Kazimierz's family for you! This time, we're traveling into the future, where Zalipie has become a post-apocalyptic, radioactive wasteland. His grandson must adapt to the new conditions and breathe new life into the farm.[/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457344/166a1b8d0ce83902469ecd317e600d753ee6e3b8.png[/img]

Due to the changes that have taken place on the farm, we’re introducing new mechanics to the game. Here are some of the features we’re currently working on and that you’ll experience during gameplay:

[list]
[*] The surrounding area is irradiated, so expanding the farm will only be possible within the protective force field dome.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/y3nMlVo.gif[/img]

[*] The player is a lone colonist, so they must take care of essentials such as electricity and clean drinking water. Some buildings and machines consume these resources, so managing them wisely is crucial. Build water purification machines and power generators to meet the growing demand.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457344/1757411a4cd0665c923cc32da727343dc83fee2d.png[/img]

[*] The future has brought technological advancements, but farming still often requires traditional methods. You can now use laser pitchforks and scythes to clean up cow pies or cut grass!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/5a4y1ko.gif[/img]

[*] Radiation-induced mutations have sometimes led to unexpected results. Some plants have adapted to survive in these harsh conditions and have started absorbing radioactive elements. Their biomass can now be used as fuel for the reactor.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45457344/014617239d4bf141af9a43d7e3f729e6fcfe29ef.png[/img]
[/list]


[h3]If you still haven't decided to [b][u]wishlist our game[/u][/b], now is the time to do it :)[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3461890/Cyber_Farmer


Get ready for a new farming experience like never before!

tags.feature: The surrounding area is irradiated, so expanding the farm will only be possible within the protective force field dome.

The player is a lone colonist, so they must take care of essentials such as electricity and clean drinking water. Some buildings and machines consume these resources, so managing them wisely is crucial. Build water purification machines and power generators to meet the growing demand.
The future has brought technological advancements, but farming still often requires traditional methods. You can now use laser pitchforks and scythes to clean up cow pies or cut grass!

Radiation-induced mutations have sometimes led to unexpected results. Some plants have adapted to survive in these harsh conditions and have started absorbing radioactive elements. Their biomass can now be used as fuel for the reactor.
